name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires the switch to have been toggled before the exit, exactly as the task states. The exit is conditional, not a goal, so the rule-only machine is valid.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been toggled first.

(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
